results.title: Sen. Legarda, son Rep. Leviste left PH separately on Aug. 2—Immigration bureau
results.description: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) and Bureau of Immigration (BI) confirmed Friday that Sen. Loren Legarda and her son Rep. Leandro Leviste left the Philippines separately on Aug. 2, Sunday.

results.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs: German authorities arrest Romanian citizen on suspicion of espionage
results.description: Romania's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MAE) announced on Thursday evening that the German authorities have executed an arrest warrant issued by the Federal Court of Justice in Rheine (North Rhine-Westphalia)
